title: Repair-Customer Discount Credit on Customer-Pay Rentals (Rental Vehicle Coordination)
content:
**Programme rule.** Under Rental Vehicle Coordination, a customer-pay rental tied to a network customer-pay repair receives a repair-customer discount credit that names the rental's time charge and is booked on the rental.

The repair-customer discount is worked out only after any amount by which the time charge was posted above the rental's correct time charge stands credited against it as a billing error.

## Business effect

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| Rentals concerned | Customer-pay rentals tied to a network customer-pay repair |
| What the credit names | The rental's time charge entry |
| Observable effect | A customer credit with reason customer-pay discount, dated the day it is booked, appears in the rental's day and money history, naming the time charge; the renter's outstanding share falls by the amount credited |

## Booking tool: `credit_repair_customer_discount_d339b3bd`

**Capability.** Books the repair-customer discount on a customer-pay replacement rental as a credit against the rental's time charge. The renter's outstanding share falls by the amount given; the credit appears in the rental's day and money history as a customer credit with reason `customer_pay_discount`, dated today, naming the charge it reduces.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `credit_repair_customer_discount_d339b3bd` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_reservation_id` | Reference number of the rental reservation, as returned by the rental reservation lookup | Id |
| `source_entry_id` | Reference number of the time charge entry the discount reduces, as returned by the rental day and money history lookup | Id |
| `amount_usd` | Discount amount credited | USD, 2 decimal places, positive; rounded half-up to the cent when booked |

**Return.** A receipt with `status` ("booked" when the discount was recorded), `rental_entry_id` (reference number of the new credit entry), `rental_reservation_id` (the reservation credited), `source_entry_id` (the time charge the discount names), `credit_reason` (always "customer_pay_discount"), `amount_usd` (the amount credited, USD with 2 decimal places) and `entry_date` (booking date, YYYY-MM-DD).

## Contract illustration (hypothetical)

A call naming a reservation, the reservation's time charge entry and an amount of 31.6449 USD books 31.64 USD and returns a receipt whose `status` reads "booked" and whose `credit_reason` reads "customer_pay_discount".
